evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Edit a JSON document using its supplied schema. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Use ObjectContentEditor when the outgoing document is data. Keep its schema as a separate input and let validity decide whether the host permits a save.
assertions: Identify the document being persisted and retain a separate schema. Done: the initial object has a string name and the schema declares that member required.
Feed onChange back as the object and onValidationChange to the save gate. Done: a valid edit appears in the emitted data without replacing the schema.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: My edited object resets after each keystroke. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: If edits disappear, inspect the object supplied on the next render; feeding the initial object back discards the emission. If a schema property is being renamed, switch editors instead of mutating schema inside a value callback.
assertions: If edits disappear, inspect the object supplied on the next render; feeding the initial object back discards the emission. If a schema property is being renamed, switch editors instead of mutating schema inside a value callback.
Feed onChange back as the object and onValidationChange to the save gate. Done: a valid edit appears in the emitted data without replacing the schema.
Clear the required field, observe its invalid state and inspect the schema again. Done: Aster was emitted as data, the empty name blocks Save, and the original schema remains unchanged.
